english: at the end of one’s tether
also: at the end of my rope
I might as well hang myself

terms.gloss: it has come to the rope: there is nothing left but to hang oneself
evidence: Ter. Ph. 686: Ad restim mihi quidem rēs rediit plānissimē.
Lewis & Short s.v. restis: “it has come to the rope, i.e. one might as well hang himself”
terms.comment: The person goes in the dative: ad restim mihi rēs rediit.

phrases.latin: operā tuā ad restim mihi quidem rēs rediit plānissimē
phrases.english: thanks to you it has quite plainly come to the rope for me
